//: How level 5 is generated. Run it with: powershell -File tools/rebuild_level.ps1 -Level level_5
notes: gen_rail_level.gd owns this level end to end and OVERWRITES every byte of it, so the
chain has a defined start and nothing here is read-modify-write. Any editor work done
on level 5 is lost on the next replay -- that is the deal, not a bug.
There is deliberately no splatmap2: nothing paints channels 4..7 here (no ballast paint,
see the tool header), so this level has three sources, not four.
The order inside the tool is the mandated authoring order -- terrain, then road plus
conform, then splat -- so the cuttings and embankments the loop carves get slope-correct

steps.why: Heightmap, rail loop curve, terrain conform, splatmap, LevelInfo and the level .tscn, all deterministic from GEN_SEED and the loop constants in the tool.
The bake reads the terrain textures, so the fresh PNGs must be reimported first.
